verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms documents all three parts of the story. It onboards and verifies sellers, service providers, or contractors. It splits payments between one or more users and can deduct costs. It holds funds until payout, so users can sign up, sell, and receive payments within one solution. Missing for 10: detailed docs on per-seller payout mechanics (seller payout schedules, bank transfer flows, split API specifics), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the platforms flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller

citations.quote: Onboard sellers, service providers, or contractors on to your platform, and let Adyen verify them before paying out. Adyen informs you of the results of the verification checks.
You can split the payments between one or more users, deduct costs as needed, and hold funds until payout.
Allow your users to easily sign up, sell, and receive payments all within one solution.
